QuestInfo.name: Stylist Vincent III
QuestInfo.0: Vincent needs more help with Vicky's styling. If you get Vicky looking like a true rock star, maybe you can learn something about the Spirit of Rock...
QuestInfo.1: Vincent wants you to get a Bunny Suit for Vicky. This sounds like a terrible plan. Go to the 5th and 6th Floor of Kerning Square and hunt Kid Mannequins to collect 50 Bunny Suits.
QuestInfo.2: Surprisingly, Vicky also loved the Bunny Suit. At this point you should probably be doubting Vicky's sense of style.

0.0: Really? Vicky liked it? SHE LIKED IT??!!
0.1: Yaaayyy!! Now onto the outfits! Help me again, pretty please?

yes.0: Hunt some Kid Mannequins and collect #b50 Bunny Suits#k. She's gonna look drop dead GORGEOUS in one of those. You can find them on the #rfifth and sixth floors#k of Kerning Square. Bring them to Vicky so she can try them on!

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: So it's the outfits now, huh?

0.msg: Barf, what is this? A Bunny Suit?! Is he serious??!! I just... My brain feels like it's gonna explode.

1.msg: On the other hand, these modern pop starlets sure do dress in some wacky things. I guess I should show that I can look good in any outfit.

2.msg: Is she trying to be optimistic or is she for real?

npc.0: Vicky will look positively stunning in a Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. You can find them on the fifth and sixth floors of Kerning Square. Hurry back and bring them to Vicky!

item.0: Where is my outfit? I can't go on stage looking like this!!
